latest_release.name: v1.27.0
latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.27.0 -->
## Known Issues
 
- If you have issues with wayland DE checkout the [Wayland support](https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/discussions/7499) discussion

## What's Changed
### Features
* Remove the generic connection failure dialog by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9498
* Suggest also ipv6 by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9505
* Make a Status bar widget by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9507
* Disable screen rename when core is running by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9515
* Settings adjust by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9531
* Window settings by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9544
* Allow for run command on enter or exit by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9564
* fix: adjust command line size to allow expanding by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9589
* Timeout longer by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9607
* Have the Messages check settings on their own by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9637
* Replace `LOG_IPC` with actual IPC by @nbolton in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9458
* Closes core upon accessibility permissions revocation by @amagus in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9579
* Improve connection stability by @AlD in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9616
* Protocol settings in main settings only.  by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9667
* feat: Print Qt logs same as other log lines by @nbolton in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9685
* feat: handle input capture session persistence by @whot in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9415
* Use QStrings for exceptions whats by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9713
* Log updates by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9726
* feat: add search evdev.xml path for NetBSD/OpenBSD by @jg1uaa in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9744
* refactor: include install info in about info by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9752
* Fix client network bind by @alizane in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9672
* Better local fingerprint preview by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9816
* Mv grid info outof server config by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9837
* Cleanup protocol remnents by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9838
* Move more to general settings by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9848
* Move more server options to new settings by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9859
* Clipboard support for Wayland (input capture and remote desktop portals) by @whot in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9431
* Move aliases to general config by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9879
* fix: defer client disconnect cleanup by @happys2333 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9958
* fix(wayland): only add input-capture barriers on the outer desktop edge by @TSUMUGI-XE in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9976
* fix: release EIS emulation grab when idle so client screens can sleep by @ElCruncharino in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9894
* Better help by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/10002
* Token in state by @sithlord48 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/10015
* feat(macos): preserve the left/right side of modifier keys on the client by @rNoz in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9916
* Accumulate smooth scroll into full wheel clicks on server by @neon12345 in https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9975
* refactor: no need to call setAppId for gui as

hot_issues.title: AltGr not sent to client from server
Clipboard content modified on copy/paste : pasting binary or Japanese characters on client
MacOS client causes high power usage when in sleep
macOS screenshots (images) cannot be pasted to Windows 11 via shared clipboard — only text works
Cursor hidden on server but keeps moving in sync with the cursor on client macOS
macOS: client traps (SIGTRAP/dispatch_assert_queue) in OSXKeyState::pollActiveGroup() on forwarded key events — TIS main-queue assert, still unguarded on master
